doc: Variable-radius Poisson discs over two FIXED size fields (the inputs: open 12 to 48 km and closed 8 to 32 km, 32x32); only the candidate draws vary with the seed. STATISTICAL: 30 seeds (1000..1029), 4 metrics (names and definitions in params). The port draws its own random numbers, so it cannot reproduce `values`; it computes each metric exactly as defined, for its own seeds, and checks |metric - mean| <= n_sigma * std per metric for one seed (n_sigma * std / sqrt(m) for the mean of m seeds). mean and std (ddof = 1) are what the Python code produces; the recomputation check holds them at 1e-9 (no flipped texel in the nudge experiments).

definitions: number of accepted points, open field
number of accepted points, closed field
mean over accepted points of (periodic distance to the nearest other accepted point) / (field size at the point, nearest-texel sample), open field
